bio.text: Amy Acton, a physician and public health expert, launched a campaign for Ohio governor in January 2025 and said she would run as a Democrat; she is a candidate for the office in 2026.

She was an associate professor of public health at Ohio State University before Gov. Mike DeWine appointed her to lead the Ohio Department of Health in 2019; she resigned that post in June 2020 and remained as his chief health adviser until August 2020.
Afterward she worked for the Columbus Foundation and later directed the city of Columbus's Project L.O.V.E., a childhood vaccination initiative. She has not previously held elective office.

sources.title: Dr. Amy Acton, who helped lead Ohio's early pandemic response, joins 2026 governor's race
